title: Case 261: Shari Smith & Debra May Helmick (Part 1/2)

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一具女性遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到斩首，体内血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她仅被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字：艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“案件档案呈现”系列的最新作品，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Friday, May 31, 1985, Bob Smith sat in his home office.
sentences.zh: 1985年5月31日，星期五下午，鲍勃·史密斯正坐在他的家庭办公室里。

sentences.en: The father of three ran a business selling electronic scoreboards and signs, a job that provided the flexibility to work from home.
sentences.zh: 这位三个孩子的父亲经营着一家销售电子记分牌和标牌的公司，这份工作让他可以灵活地在家办公。

sentences.en: The arrangement was particularly welcome on this unseasonably hot day, as it allowed Bob to relax by the pool with his wife before sitting down to do some work.
sentences.zh: 在这个反常炎热的日子里，这种工作安排显得格外惬意，因为鲍勃可以在开始工作前，先和妻子在泳池边放松一下。

sentences.en: At around 3.30pm, Bob looked out the window.
sentences.zh: 下午3点30分左右，鲍勃向窗外望去。

sentences.en: His office was on the second floor of his family's South Carolina home, with views over the expansive front yard of their large rural property.
sentences.zh: 他的办公室位于这栋南卡罗来纳州住宅的二楼，可以俯瞰他们那片广阔乡村庄园的前院。

sentences.en: At the end of the 750ft-long driveway, Bob saw the familiar side of his daughter's blue Chevy Chevette hatchback.
sentences.zh: 在750英尺长的车道尽头，鲍勃看到了女儿那辆熟悉的蓝色雪佛兰Chevette掀背车。

sentences.en: The car belonged to 17-year-old Sharon Faye Smith, or Shari as she preferred to be called.
sentences.zh: 这辆车属于17岁的莎伦·费伊·史密斯，她更喜欢别人叫她莎莉。

sentences.en: Shari was returning home from a pool party at the home of a classmate.
sentences.zh: 莎莉刚从一位同学家的泳池派对回来。

sentences.en: As was her habit, she stopped at the end of the driveway to check the mailbox before heading down to the house.
sentences.zh: 按照习惯，她在开车回家前，先在车道尽头停下查看邮箱。

sentences.en: Bob got back to work.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃回到工作岗位上。

sentences.en: But after five minutes or so, the house was noticeably quiet.
sentences.zh: 但大约五分钟后，家里安静得有些反常。

sentences.en: Shari usually burst in, eager to say hello to her parents and tell them about her day.
sentences.zh: 莎莉通常会风风火火地冲进来，急着跟父母打招呼，分享她一天的见闻。

sentences.en: Bob looked outside and noticed that Shari's Chevette was still idling at the end of the driveway.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃向外看去，发现莎莉的Chevette车仍然停在车道尽头，引擎还在空转。

sentences.en: He wondered if she had received a letter and was reading it in her car.
sentences.zh: 他心想，她是不是收到了什么信，正在车里读呢。

sentences.en: Minutes passed and Shari's car didn't budge.
sentences.zh: 几分钟过去了，莎莉的车纹丝不动。

sentences.en: Bob got a bad feeling.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃产生了一种不祥的预感。

sentences.en: Shari had a rare disease called diabetes insipidus, commonly known as water diabetes.
sentences.zh: 莎莉患有一种罕见的疾病，叫尿崩症，俗称“水糖尿病”。

sentences.en: The condition was characterised by a hormone malfunction that prevented Shari's kidneys from retaining water, resulting in extreme thirst and frequent urination.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病的特征是激素功能失调，导致莎莉的肾脏无法保留水分，从而引起极度口渴和频繁排尿。

sentences.en: Without her medication or large quantities of water, Shari was under the constant threat of severe and even fatal dehydration.
sentences.zh: 如果没有药物或大量水分，莎莉时刻面临着严重甚至致命的脱水威胁。

sentences.en: Therefore, she never went anywhere without her medication.
sentences.zh: 因此，她去任何地方都随身带着药物。

sentences.en: Bob considered whether Shari could have ducked behind a nearby bush to urinate.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃猜测莎莉是不是躲到附近的灌木丛后去小便了。

sentences.en: The Smiths' driveway jutted off Platte Springs Road, a long stretch roughly 10 miles outside the town of Lexington.
sentences.zh: 史密斯家的车道连接着普拉特斯普林斯路，那是一条位于列克星敦镇外约10英里处的长路。

sentences.en: It was a quiet spot surrounded by woodland and Shari could have easily relieved herself without anyone noticing.
sentences.zh: 那里环境清幽，四周环绕着林地，莎莉完全可以在不被发现的情况下解决内急。

sentences.en: Worst case scenario, she might have become dehydrated and disorientated or maybe even lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 最坏的情况是，她可能因为脱水而神志不清，甚至昏迷过去。

sentences.en: Not wanting to take any chances, Bob jumped into his own car and quickly drove to the end of the driveway.
sentences.zh: 为了保险起见，鲍勃跳上自己的车，迅速开往车道尽头。

sentences.en: The engine of Shari's car was still running.
sentences.zh: 莎莉车的引擎还在运转。

sentences.en: The driver's side door was open and mail was scattered on the ground.
sentences.zh: 驾驶座一侧的车门开着，邮件散落在地上。

sentences.en: Bob got out of his car and peered inside of Shari's shavat.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃下了车，往莎莉的车里看去。

sentences.en: The keys were still in the ignition and the damp towel she'd taken to the pool party lay across the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 钥匙还插在点火开关上，她带去泳池派对的湿毛巾横在驾驶座上。

sentences.en: Beside it, on the passenger seat, sat Shari's handbag.
sentences.zh: 旁边副驾驶座上放着莎莉的手提包。

sentences.en: Her medication and wallet were inside.
sentences.zh: 她的药物和钱包都在里面。

sentences.en: The sandals she'd been wearing that day were sitting on the floor.
sentences.zh: 她当天穿的凉鞋放在地板上。

sentences.en: Bare footprints led from the car to the mailbox, but they stopped there.
sentences.zh: 光脚的脚印从车旁一直延伸到邮箱处，但到那里就中断了。

sentences.en: Shari herself was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.zh: 莎莉本人不见踪影。

sentences.en: Officers from the Lexington County Sheriff's Department were called and quickly arrived on the scene.
sentences.zh: 列克星敦县治安官部门的警员接到报案后，迅速赶到了现场。

sentences.en: Bob Smith and his wife Hilda assured the police that Shari had no reason to run off.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·史密斯和妻子希尔达向警方保证，莎莉没有理由离家出走。

sentences.en: She was in the prime of her life, set to graduate from high school with honours in just a few days.
sentences.zh: 她正值青春年华，再过几天就要以优异的成绩从高中毕业了。

sentences.en: Shari was a talented singer and she'd been given the honour of singing the national anthem at the school's graduation ceremony.
sentences.zh: 莎莉是一位才华横溢的歌手，学校还授予她荣誉，让她在毕业典礼上领唱国歌。

sentences.en: She'd been looking forward to it immensely.
sentences.zh: 她对此一直充满期待。

sentences.en: A born performer, Shari had been accepted to study music at Columbia College in South Carolina later that year.
sentences.zh: 作为天生的表演者，莎莉已被南卡罗来纳州的哥伦比亚学院录取，将于今年晚些时候去学习音乐。

sentences.en: In the meantime, she and her graduating classmates would be celebrating the end of their schooling with a cruise to the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，她和毕业班的同学们还计划去巴哈马群岛游轮旅行，庆祝学业结束。

sentences.en: For her parents, the only explanation for Shari's disappearance was that something terrible had happened.
sentences.zh: 对她的父母来说，莎莉失踪的唯一解释就是发生了可怕的事情。

sentences.en: Shari was particularly close to her older sister, 21-year-old Dawn, who was already living away from home while studying.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和她21岁的姐姐道恩关系特别亲密，道恩当时已经在校外寄宿读书。

sentences.en: The siblings shared a love for singing and often performed gospel favourites around Lexington.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩都热爱唱歌，经常在列克星敦各地表演福音歌曲。

sentences.en: As soon as Shari disappeared, an officer was summoned to collect Dawn from the nearby city of Charlotte and drive her back to Lexington.
sentences.zh: 莎莉失踪后，警方立即派人前往附近的夏洛特市接回道恩，并带她回到列克星敦。

sentences.en: Dawn admitted to police that her father was strict and that this could sometimes be a source of angst for Shari.
sentences.zh: 道恩向警方承认，父亲管教严厉，这有时会让莎莉感到苦恼。

sentences.en: Shari had occasionally expressed a desire to go stay with Dawn, but never under any circumstances did Dawn think her little sister would take off on her own.
sentences.zh: 莎莉偶尔表达过想去道恩那里住的念头，但道恩绝不认为妹妹会独自离家出走。

sentences.en: Theirs was a close-knit family and although Shari craved a bit more freedom, she knew her parents always had her best interest at heart.
sentences.zh: 他们是一个关系紧密的家庭，尽管莎莉渴望多一点自由，但她知道父母总是为她着想。

sentences.en: Even on the unlikely chance that Shari could have run away, she wouldn't leave her life-saving medication behind.
sentences.zh: 即便莎莉真的会离家出走，她也不可能丢下救命的药物。

sentences.en: Police didn't believe the Smiths had anything to hide and they wasted no time in launching a full-scale missing persons investigation.
sentences.zh: 警方认为史密斯一家没有隐瞒任何情况，随即展开了全面的失踪人口调查。

sentences.en: Within hours, hundreds of locals braved the sweltering heat to traverse the rugged terrain surrounding the Smiths' 10-acre property.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，数百名当地人顶着酷暑，搜寻了史密斯家10英亩土地周围崎岖的地形。

sentences.en: Police looked for tyre tracks, shoe prints or anything else that could provide a clue as to Shari's whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 警方寻找轮胎痕迹、鞋印或任何能提供莎莉下落线索的东西。

sentences.en: They found nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们一无所获。

sentences.en: Had Shari become disorientated due to her medical condition, they didn't think she would have wandered far.
sentences.zh: 如果莎莉是因为病情发作而神志不清，他们认为她应该走不远。

sentences.en: A member of the search party was checking Platte Springs Road, about half a mile from the Smiths' home, when they found a red bandana.
sentences.zh: 搜寻队的一名成员在距离史密斯家约半英里的普拉特斯普林斯路搜查时，发现了一条红色头巾。

sentences.en: It was believed to belong to Shari.
sentences.zh: 人们认为这属于莎莉。

sentences.en: Police wondered whether she could have intentionally left it behind as some sort of clue.
sentences.zh: 警方怀疑她是否是有意留下它作为某种线索。

sentences.en: As the hours passed, with no sign of the teenager, police became steadfastly convinced that Shari's disappearance wasn't the result of her diabetes.
sentences.zh: 随着时间流逝，依然没有这名少女的踪迹，警方坚定地认为莎莉的失踪并非糖尿病所致。

sentences.en: Someone had taken her against her will.
sentences.zh: 有人违背她的意愿带走了她。

sentences.en: The last person to see Shari was her boyfriend, Richard Lawson.
sentences.zh: 最后见到莎莉的人是她的男友理查德·劳森。

sentences.en: The two had spent the morning in downtown Lexington organising traveller's checks for Shari's upcoming cruise.
sentences.zh: 两人当天上午在列克星敦市中心为莎莉即将到来的游轮旅行办理旅行支票。

sentences.en: Once they were done, Shari left her chevette in the shopping centre car park and drove in Richard's car to their friend's pool party.
sentences.zh: 办完后，莎莉把Chevette车留在购物中心停车场，坐理查德的车去了朋友家的泳池派对。

sentences.en: The couple spent a few hours there before Shari called her parents at around 2.30pm to say she was about to head home.
sentences.zh: 两人在那里待了几个小时，下午2点30分左右，莎莉给父母打了电话，说她准备回家了。

sentences.en: Shari and her younger brother, 15-year-old Robert, were expected to check in with their parents every now and then to keep them in the loop of their plans.
sentences.zh: 莎莉和她15岁的弟弟罗伯特被要求不时向父母报备，让他们了解自己的行程。

sentences.en: Police cast a suspicious eye on Richard Lawson, but Shari's family didn't think there was any chance he would cause her any harm.
sentences.zh: 警方对理查德·劳森产生了怀疑，但史密斯一家认为他绝不可能伤害莎莉。

sentences.en: Shari adored Richard.
sentences.zh: 莎莉深爱着理查德。

sentences.en: He was an upstanding young man and the two were head over heels in love.
sentences.zh: 他是个正直的年轻人，两人正坠入爱河。

sentences.en: They'd both been accepted to Columbia College and were excited to be starting the next chapter of their lives together.
sentences.zh: 他们都被哥伦比亚学院录取，对共同开启人生的新篇章感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Regardless, police questioned Richard.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，警方还是审问了理查德。

sentences.en: He said that after leaving the pool party, he dropped Shari back to her car in downtown Lexington.
sentences.zh: 他说离开泳池派对后，他把莎莉送回了列克星敦市中心的车里。

sentences.en: The two sat in her car talking for about 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 两人在车里坐着聊了大约15分钟。

sentences.en: After that, Richard said he kissed Shari goodbye and got back into his own car.
sentences.zh: 之后，理查德说他吻别了莎莉，回到了自己的车里。

sentences.en: They shared the same route home, so Richard trailed behind Shari for a while before turning off in the direction of his own home.
sentences.zh: 他们回家的路线相同，所以理查德跟在莎莉后面走了一段路，然后才转向回家的方向。

sentences.en: According to Richard, he went straight home and didn't leave the house thereafter.
sentences.zh: 据理查德说，他直接回了家，之后就没再出门。

sentences.en: His alibi checked out.
sentences.zh: 他的不在场证明经核实无误。

sentences.en: This put Shari arriving home alone at around 3.30pm.
sentences.zh: 这意味着莎莉是在下午3点30分左右独自到家的。

sentences.en: Some passers-by had seen her standing at her mailbox, about to peer inside.
sentences.zh: 一些路人看到她站在邮箱旁，正准备往里看。

sentences.en: They hadn't noticed anything odd or suspicious, but they did recall seeing an unusual vehicle in the neighbourhood around this time.
sentences.zh: 他们没发现任何异常或可疑之处，但确实记得当时在附近看到了一辆不同寻常的车。

sentences.en: The car was described as a late-model Oldsmobile or Pontiac in a cranberry colour.
sentences.zh: 那辆车被描述为一辆深红色的旧款奥兹莫比尔或庞蒂亚克。

sentences.en: One witness recalled glancing in their rear-view mirror and seeing the vehicle stop in the Smiths' driveway.
sentences.zh: 一位目击者回忆说，他们瞥了一眼后视镜，看到那辆车停在史密斯家的车道上。

sentences.en: They caught a glimpse of the driver, describing him as a male aged in his 30s.
sentences.zh: 他们瞥见了司机，描述他是一名30多岁的男性。

sentences.en: When they drove past again about 10 minutes later, Shari's car was still there, but Shari herself wasn't.
sentences.zh: 大约10分钟后他们再次开车经过时，莎莉的车还在那里，但莎莉本人不见了。

sentences.en: Given that the Smiths' mail was scattered on the ground,
sentences.zh: 鉴于史密斯家的邮件散落在地上，

sentences.en: police theorised that Shari's abductor had accosted her at the mailbox shortly after Bob Smith looked away from the window of his home office.
sentences.zh: 警方推测，就在鲍勃·史密斯从家庭办公室窗前移开视线后不久，绑架者就在邮箱旁袭击了莎莉。

sentences.en: The fact that Bob hadn't witnessed the incident was sheer bad luck.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃没目睹这一事件纯属不幸。

sentences.en: By all accounts, Shari Smith was a popular, well-liked and vibrant young woman.
sentences.zh: 据各方评价，莎莉·史密斯是一个受欢迎、讨人喜欢且充满活力的年轻女性。

sentences.en: She was actively involved in her school community and had been recently voted wittiest girl by her senior class.
sentences.zh: 她积极参与学校社区活动，最近还被高年级同学投票选为“最风趣女生”。

sentences.en: As a devoted member of Lexington's First Baptist Church, she took her faith very seriously and wasn't involved in drugs or any nefarious behaviour.
sentences.zh: 作为列克星敦第一浸信会的虔诚成员，她非常看重信仰，从不接触毒品或任何不法行为。

sentences.en: But, to police, this didn't seem like an opportunistic attack.
sentences.zh: 但对警方来说，这看起来不像是一起随机袭击。

sentences.en: If Shari hadn't been targeted by a known enemy, police speculated whether someone could have followed her home.
sentences.zh: 如果莎莉不是被已知的敌人盯上，警方推测是否有人跟踪她回了家。

sentences.en: The blonde-haired, blue-eyed Shari was described as strikingly attractive.
sentences.zh: 金发碧眼的莎莉被形容为极其迷人。

sentences.en: Someone could have noticed her either before or after the pool party and been captivated by her physical appearance enough to covertly watch and trail her vehicle.
sentences.zh: 有人可能在泳池派对前后注意到了她，并被她的外貌所吸引，以至于暗中观察并跟踪了她的车。

sentences.en: Or perhaps they'd been stalking Shari for a while.
sentences.zh: 或者，他们可能已经跟踪莎莉一段时间了。

sentences.en: Shari worked part-time at a local flea market.
sentences.zh: 莎莉在当地的一个跳蚤市场兼职工作。

sentences.en: Police learned that just two weeks prior, a male customer had been kicked out of the market for harassing Shari and other young women.
sentences.zh: 警方获悉，就在两周前，一名男性顾客因骚扰莎莉和其他年轻女性而被赶出了市场。

sentences.en: The Smiths were an influential family in Lexington.
sentences.zh: 史密斯一家在列克星敦是有影响力的人家。

sentences.en: Shari's father, Bob, volunteered as a chaplain for the Sheriff's Department as well as the county jail and youth correctional facilities.
sentences.zh: 莎莉的父亲鲍勃是治安官部门、县监狱和青少年管教所的志愿牧师。

sentences.en: He and his wife Hilda often sang hymns to those incarcerated, and they were sometimes joined by Shari and Dawn.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子希尔达经常为囚犯演唱赞美诗，莎莉和道恩有时也会加入。

sentences.en: Police considered the possibility that a former inmate could have developed an obsession with Shari and tracked her down upon their release.
sentences.zh: 警方考虑过是否有一名前囚犯对莎莉产生了执念，并在获释后追踪了她。

sentences.en: Alternatively, what if an inmate had it out for Bob Smith and targeted Shari as part of some deranged revenge plot?
sentences.zh: 或者，有没有可能是某个囚犯对鲍勃·史密斯怀恨在心，将莎莉作为某种疯狂复仇计划的目标？

sentences.en: Inquiries were made into former inmates who had crossed paths with Bob or Shari Smith, but there was no evidence to implicate any of them in the kidnapping.
sentences.zh: 警方调查了曾与鲍勃或莎莉·史密斯有过交集的前囚犯，但没有证据表明他们中任何一人与绑架案有关。

sentences.en: With no obvious suspects emerging, police considered whether Shari's abduction could have been financially motivated.
sentences.zh: 在没有明显嫌疑人的情况下，警方考虑莎莉的绑架是否出于经济动机。

sentences.en: The Smiths weren't particularly wealthy,
sentences.zh: 史密斯家并不算特别富有，

sentences.en: but the income they earned through Bob's electronic sales and Hilda's part-time work as a substitute teacher afforded them a comfortable lifestyle with an impressively large house.
sentences.zh: 但鲍勃的电子产品销售收入和希尔达作为代课老师的兼职收入，让他们过着舒适的生活，并拥有一栋令人印象深刻的大房子。

sentences.en: Although the family seemed like an unlikely choice to target, police had to consider.
sentences.zh: 虽然这个家庭看起来不太像是绑架目标，但警方不得不考虑。

sentences.en: What if Shari had been kidnapped for ransom?
sentences.zh: 如果莎莉是被绑架勒索赎金呢？

sentences.en: Later that night, as the search for Shari continued, the Smiths' home phone rang.
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，搜寻工作仍在继续，史密斯家的电话响了。

sentences.en: On the other line was an unknown male.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一个身份不明的男子。

sentences.en: I have Shari, he said.
sentences.zh: “莎莉在我手里，”他说，“我要钱。”

sentences.en: I want money.
sentences.zh: “我要钱。”

sentences.en: Anticipating a call of this nature, police had installed a phone tap which allowed them to trace the call to a phone booth in an undisclosed location.
sentences.zh: 预料到会有此类电话，警方安装了电话窃听装置，这使他们能够追踪到该电话来自一个位置不明的公用电话亭。

sentences.en: The caller was identified as 27-year-old Edward Robertson, but any hopes that Shari would be returned were short-lived when the call was determined to be a hoax.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人被确认为27岁的爱德华·罗伯逊，但当确定该电话是恶作剧时，莎莉能被平安送回的希望破灭了。

sentences.en: Robertson was hit with multiple charges, including extortion and obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 罗伯逊被控多项罪名，包括勒索和妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: The bogus ransom was a huge waste of police resources for a case where time was well and truly of the essence.
sentences.zh: 对于一个分秒必争的案件来说，这起虚假的勒索电话是对警力资源的巨大浪费。

sentences.en: Without Shari's medication, there was the very real possibility that she could become dehydrated enough to slip into a coma.
sentences.zh: 没有莎莉的药物，她极有可能因严重脱水而陷入昏迷。

sentences.en: When there was no sign of Shari Smith by the following morning, planes equipped with infrared technology were sent down by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上仍不见莎莉·史密斯的踪影，联邦调查局派出了配备红外技术的飞机进行搜寻。

sentences.en: Authorities from surrounding counties were brought in to assist, while a trailer was set up in front of the Smith family home to act as investigation headquarters.
sentences.zh: 周边县的当局也被调来协助，史密斯家门前搭建了一个拖车作为调查指挥部。

sentences.en: Led by Lexington County Sheriff James Matts, the search for the 17-year-old quickly became the largest manhunt in South Carolina's history.
sentences.zh: 在列克星敦县治安官詹姆斯·马茨的领导下，对这名17岁少女的搜寻迅速成为南卡罗来纳州历史上最大规模的搜捕行动。

sentences.en: A report came in that Shari had recently been threatened by some other students from her high school.
sentences.zh: 有报告称，莎莉最近受到过高中其他学生的威胁。

sentences.en: Police looked into these claims and questioned every other guest who'd attended the pool party with Shari the day before, but no further leads emerged.
sentences.zh: 警方调查了这些说法，并询问了前一天与莎莉一起参加泳池派对的所有客人，但没有发现进一步的线索。

sentences.en: By Sunday, the full weight of Shari's disappearance was felt as her high school graduation ceremony went ahead without her.
sentences.zh: 到了周日，随着高中毕业典礼在没有莎莉的情况下如期举行，人们深切感受到了她失踪带来的沉重打击。

sentences.en: Classmates couldn't ignore the enormity of the situation as a chair reserved for Shari sat empty and the National Anthem was performed by another student.
sentences.zh: 同学们无法忽视这一严峻局势，莎莉预留的座位空着，国歌由另一名学生演唱。

sentences.en: A friend of Shari's told the state newspaper,
sentences.zh: 莎莉的一位朋友告诉当地报纸，

sentences.en: When Lexington local Betty Harris, not her real name, saw the media coverage of Shari's disappearance, it sparked a memory.
sentences.zh: 当列克星敦当地人贝蒂·哈里斯（化名）看到关于莎莉失踪的媒体报道时，她想起了一件事。

sentences.en: On the afternoon of Friday May 31, Betty had been driving down Platte Springs Road when she saw a young blonde woman walking towards her mailbox.
sentences.zh: 5月31日星期五下午，贝蒂开车经过普拉特斯普林斯路时，看到一名年轻的金发女子正走向邮箱。

sentences.en: A man was approaching.
sentences.zh: 一名男子正向她走去。

sentences.en: A couple of minutes later, Betty was continuing down the road when she saw the blonde from the mailbox in the passenger seat of a reddish-coloured car.
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，贝蒂继续沿路行驶，看到邮箱旁的那位金发女子坐在了一辆红褐色汽车的副驾驶座上。

sentences.en: It was being driven by a male who looked to be between 35 and 40 years of age, with a medium build and receding, light-coloured hair.
sentences.zh: 开车的是一名看起来在35到40岁之间的男子，中等身材，发际线后移，浅色头发。

sentences.en: The car overtook Betty before slowing down to a point that she was forced to bib her horn.
sentences.zh: 那辆车超过了贝蒂，随后减速，导致她不得不按喇叭。

sentences.en: Betty could see that the man was distracted by his female passenger.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂能看出那名男子被副驾驶座上的女乘客分散了注意力。

sentences.en: She didn't think much of it until she saw the news and realised that the young woman she'd seen was Shari Smith.
sentences.zh: 她当时没多想，直到看到新闻，才意识到她看到的年轻女子就是莎莉·史密斯。

sentences.en: The composite sketches of the man provided by Betty and other witnesses were notably different.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂和其他目击者提供的男子模拟画像有显著差异。

sentences.en: However, their descriptions of his cranberry vehicle were all similar.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们对那辆红褐色车辆的描述却大同小异。

sentences.en: Instead of focusing on identifying the suspect by his appearance, police focused on identifying his car.
sentences.zh: 警方不再专注于通过外貌识别嫌疑人，而是专注于识别他的车。

sentences.en: They collated a list of anyone Shari associated with who drove a similar vehicle, including attendees at her church.
sentences.zh: 他们整理了一份与莎莉有往来且驾驶类似车辆的人员名单，包括她教会的成员。

sentences.en: But, as the search rolled into its third fruitless day, grave concerns were held for Shari's welfare.
sentences.zh: 但是，随着搜寻进入第三天却毫无进展，人们对莎莉的安危深感担忧。

sentences.en: Even if her kidnapper hadn't caused Shari any harm, they'd need to be giving her copious amounts of water to ensure her survival.
sentences.zh: 即使绑架者没有伤害莎莉，他们也需要给她提供大量的水以确保她存活。

sentences.en: It had been an agonising couple of days for the Smith family.
sentences.zh: 这对史密斯一家来说是痛苦的几天。

sentences.en: They gathered in their home, comforted by a passing procession of concerned friends and relatives who brought them meals and joined them in prayer.
sentences.zh: 他们聚集在家里，在络绎不绝的亲友慰问中得到安慰，亲友们为他们送来食物并与他们一起祈祷。

sentences.en: A team of investigators stationed themselves on the property round the clock, ready to act the moment any potential lead came through.
sentences.zh: 一个调查小组全天候驻扎在庄园里，准备在任何潜在线索出现时立即采取行动。

sentences.en: The Lexington community was on edge.
sentences.zh: 列克星敦社区人心惶惶。

sentences.en: Parents kept watchful eyes on their children, while young women avoided going out alone, fearful of the unknown.
sentences.zh: 父母们紧盯着自己的孩子，年轻女性不敢独自出门，对未知充满恐惧。

sentences.en: Then, at 2.20am on Monday June 3rd, Shari's father, Bob, was awoken from a restless sleep by the ringing of the phone.
sentences.zh: 随后，在6月3日星期一凌晨2点20分，莎莉的父亲鲍勃被电话铃声从不安的睡眠中惊醒。

sentences.en: Bob answered.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃接了电话。

sentences.en: The muffled, distorted voice of an unfamiliar man was on the other line.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一个陌生男人低沉且扭曲的声音。

sentences.en: He asked to speak to Mrs Smith.
sentences.zh: 他要求和史密斯夫人通话。

sentences.en: Bob beckoned to his wife Hilda and she picked up the receiver.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃向妻子希尔达示意，她接过了听筒。

sentences.en: It was the call they'd been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们一直在等待的电话。

sentences.en: The man claimed that he had Shari.
sentences.zh: 那男人声称莎莉在他手上。

sentences.en: To prove this wasn't a hoax, he described in detail the outfit that Shari had been wearing at the time she went missing,
sentences.zh: 为了证明这不是恶作剧，他详细描述了莎莉失踪时穿的衣服，

sentences.en: right down to the black and yellow bikini she had on underneath.
sentences.zh: 甚至连她里面穿的黑黄相间的比基尼都说了出来。

sentences.en: The man assured Hilda that her daughter was fine.
sentences.zh: 那男人向希尔达保证，她的女儿很好。

sentences.en: She was eating and drinking plenty of water.
sentences.zh: 她正在吃东西，也喝了很多水。

sentences.en: The man said he was going to release Shari.
sentences.zh: 那男人说他打算放了莎莉。

sentences.en: The Smiths would be receiving more information in a letter from Shari that would arrive at 2pm the following day.
sentences.zh: 史密斯一家会在第二天下午两点收到莎莉寄来的一封信，里面会有更多信息。

sentences.en: In the meantime, the caller concluded.
sentences.zh: “在此期间，”通话者总结道，

sentences.en: They are looking in the wrong place.
sentences.zh: “你们找错地方了。”

sentences.en: Tell Sheriff Metz to get on Channel 10 at 7am and call off the search.
sentences.zh: “告诉梅茨警长，明天早上七点在10频道上喊话，取消搜查。”

sentences.en: At the time, technology required a caller to be on the phone for 15 minutes before their location could be ascertained.
sentences.zh: 当时的技术要求通话者在线至少15分钟才能确定其位置。

sentences.en: Given the call was short, an instant trace couldn't be established.
sentences.zh: 由于通话时间很短，无法进行即时追踪。

sentences.en: After some time, the call was traced to a phone booth outside of a grocery store approximately 12 miles from the Smiths' home.
sentences.zh: 过了一段时间，电话被追踪到距离史密斯家约12英里处一家杂货店外的电话亭。

sentences.en: Officers rushed to the scene, but the booth was empty.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到现场，但电话亭里空无一人。

sentences.en: A dust for fingerprints revealed no discernible clues.
sentences.zh: 指纹采集没有发现任何明显的线索。

sentences.en: Investigators weren't entirely sure what to make of the call.
sentences.zh: 调查人员并不完全确定该如何看待这通电话。

sentences.en: The details about Shari's bikini hadn't been reported on, which added credibility to the caller's claiMs.
sentences.zh: 关于莎莉比基尼的细节此前并未报道过，这增加了通话者说法的可信度。

sentences.en: But beyond that, the alleged captor hadn't provided any concrete evidence to prove that he had Shari or that she was indeed alive.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，所谓的绑架者没有提供任何确凿证据来证明他确实抓了莎莉，或者她还活着。

sentences.en: Furthermore, he hadn't made any ransom demands, which raised questions about the purpose of his call.
sentences.zh: 此外，他没有提出任何赎金要求，这让人对这通电话的目的产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: Regardless, the police were taking no chances.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，警方不敢掉以轻心。

sentences.en: The owner of the Lexington Post Office was alerted and at 4am he was joined by two officers to collectively sift through every piece of mail addressed within the county.
sentences.zh: 列克星敦邮局的负责人接到了通知，凌晨4点，两名警官与他会合，共同筛查了县内所有寄出的邮件。

sentences.en: It was a painstaking task.
sentences.zh: 这是一项艰苦的工作。

sentences.en: The hours ticked by with no sign of the supposed letter, leading to doubts as to whether it existed at all.
sentences.zh: 时间一分一秒过去，却不见那封所谓的信，人们开始怀疑它是否真的存在。

sentences.en: Then, at 7am, success.
sentences.zh: 然后，在早上7点，成功了。

sentences.en: The white legal-sized envelope was addressed to the Smith family home in scrawling handwriting.
sentences.zh: 那个白色的法律信封上用潦草的字迹写着史密斯家的地址。

sentences.en: Inside was a two-page letter written on yellow legal paper, signed by Shari Smith.
sentences.zh: 里面是一封写在黄色法律用纸上的两页信，署名是莎莉·史密斯。

sentences.en: Dated June 1st at 3.10am, the title of the letter gave investigators pause.
sentences.zh: 信的日期是6月1日凌晨3点10分，信的标题让调查人员感到迟疑。

sentences.en: Written in cursive at the top of the page were the words,
sentences.zh: 页面顶部用草书写着：

sentences.en: Last will and testament.
sentences.zh: 遗嘱。

sentences.en: The letter began,
sentences.zh: 信的开头写道：

sentences.en: I love you mummy, daddy, Robert, Dawn and Richard and everyone else.
sentences.zh: 我爱你们，妈妈、爸爸、罗伯特、道恩、理查德，还有其他人。

sentences.en: I'll be with my father now, so please, please don't worry.
sentences.zh: 我现在要去找我的父亲了，所以请千万、千万不要担心。

sentences.en: Just remember my witty personality and the great special times we all shared together.
sentences.zh: 只要记住我风趣的性格，以及我们在一起度过的美好时光就好。

sentences.en: Please don't ever let this ruin your lives.
sentences.zh: 请千万不要让这件事毁了你们的生活。

sentences.en: Just keep living one day at a time for Jesus.
sentences.zh: 为了耶稣，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Some good will come out of this.
sentences.zh: 这其中会有好的结果。

sentences.en: As the letter continued, Shari apologised for any disappointment she might have caused and urged someone else to take her place on the upcoming cruise.
sentences.zh: 信中继续写道，莎莉为她可能造成的任何失望表示歉意，并敦促其他人代替她去参加即将到来的游轮旅行。

sentences.en: She reiterated how proud she was of her family and how much she loved them all.
sentences.zh: 她重申了她为家人感到多么自豪，以及她有多么爱他们所有人。

sentences.en: The letter concluded,
sentences.zh: 信的结尾写道：

sentences.en: I know you all love me and will miss me very much, but if you'll stick together like we always did, you all can do it.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们都爱我，也会非常想念我，但只要你们像往常一样团结在一起，你们一定能挺过去。

sentences.en: Please do not become hard or upset.
sentences.zh: 请不要变得冷漠或沮丧。

sentences.en: Everything works out for the good for those that love the Lord.
sentences.zh: 万事都互相效力，叫爱神的人得益处。

sentences.en: There was no return address.
sentences.zh: 信上没有回信地址。

sentences.en: When Bob Smith was shown the letter, a desperate helplessness washed over him.
sentences.zh: 当鲍勃·史密斯看到这封信时，一种绝望的无助感涌上心头。

sentences.en: He immediately recognised the handwriting as his daughter's.
sentences.zh: 他立刻认出那是他女儿的笔迹。

sentences.en: The caller had been right.
sentences.zh: 那个打电话的人是对的。

sentences.en: This was no hoax.
sentences.zh: 这不是恶作剧。

sentences.en: But it wasn't just the title of the letter or the final farewells it contained that escalated concerns about the abductor's intentions for Shari.
sentences.zh: 但不仅仅是信的标题或其中包含的最后告别，让人们对绑架者对待莎莉的意图感到更加担忧。

sentences.en: At the end of one paragraph, she'd written in parenthesis the haunting words,
sentences.zh: 在一段话的末尾，她用括号写下了令人毛骨悚然的话：

sentences.en: Casket closed.
sentences.zh: 棺材盖上。

sentences.en: A cursory examination of the letter revealed no fingerprints or any other identifying clues.
sentences.zh: 对信件的初步检查没有发现指纹或任何其他可识别的线索。

sentences.en: All investigators had to go by was the postage stamp, a commemorative duck decoy.
sentences.zh: 调查人员唯一能利用的就是邮票，那是一枚纪念鸭子诱饵的邮票。

sentences.en: But this was of little help as the stamp was a relatively recent design and was currently in wide circulation.
sentences.zh: 但这没什么帮助，因为这种邮票的设计相对较新，目前正在广泛流通。

sentences.en: Although the envelope did confirm one helpful detail.
sentences.zh: 不过，信封确实确认了一个有用的细节。

sentences.en: It was postmarked June 1 from the City of Columbia, just 13 miles east of Lexington.
sentences.zh: 它盖有6月1日从哥伦比亚市寄出的邮戳，该市位于列克星敦以东仅13英里处。

sentences.en: Wherever Shari had been taken, it couldn't be too far.
sentences.zh: 无论莎莉被带到了哪里，都不会太远。

sentences.en: The letter was immediately sent for detailed forensic testing, a process that could take weeks.
sentences.zh: 这封信立即被送去进行详细的法医鉴定，这个过程可能需要数周时间。

sentences.en: In the meantime, Bob and Hilda Smith made an impassioned plea on television, with Bob urging,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，鲍勃和希尔达·史密斯在电视上发出了恳切的呼吁，鲍勃敦促道：

sentences.en: Whoever it is that has our daughter Shari, we want her back.
sentences.zh: 无论你是谁，抓走了我们的女儿莎莉，我们想要她回来。

sentences.en: We miss her.
sentences.zh: 我们想念她。

sentences.en: We love her.
sentences.zh: 我们爱她。

sentences.en: Please send her back home where she belongs.
sentences.zh: 请把她送回她该在的地方，送回家。

sentences.en: Hilda added,
sentences.zh: 希尔达补充道：

sentences.en: She is so important to us.
sentences.zh: 她对我们来说太重要了。

sentences.en: Nothing in the world is more important.
sentences.zh: 世界上没有什么比这更重要了。

sentences.en: Right now, all we ask is just whoever you are, send Shari back home.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们唯一的请求就是，无论你是谁，请把莎莉送回家。

sentences.en: A $15,000 reward for information was announced, with one officer declaring,
sentences.zh: 悬赏15000美元征集线索的消息公布了，一名警官宣称：

sentences.en: The search is not going to stop as long as there is hope.
sentences.zh: 只要还有希望，搜查就不会停止。

sentences.en: Anticipating that Shari's abductor would call again, investigators set up a recording device on the Smith family's home phone.
sentences.zh: 预料到莎莉的绑架者会再次来电，调查人员在史密斯家的电话上安装了录音设备。

sentences.en: If he did make contact, the Smiths were advised to keep him on the line for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 如果他再次联系，建议史密斯一家尽量让他在线时间长一些。

sentences.en: At 3.08pm that same Monday, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 那个周一的下午3点08分，电话响了。

sentences.en: Shari's sister Dawn answered.
sentences.zh: 莎莉的妹妹道恩接了电话。

sentences.en: It was the same male caller from earlier.
sentences.zh: 还是之前那个男声。

sentences.en: He asked to speak to her mother.
sentences.zh: 他要求和她母亲通话。

sentences.en: The call was soon traced to a payphone at a pharmacy in Lexington.
sentences.zh: 电话很快被追踪到列克星敦一家药店的公用电话亭。

sentences.en: There was no sign of the caller or any discernible clues.
sentences.zh: 现场没有发现通话者的踪迹，也没有明显的线索。

sentences.en: However, the location itself was of particular intereSt.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个地点本身特别引人关注。

sentences.en: The pharmacy was part of the same shopping centre where Shari had parked her car while attending the pool party on Friday.
sentences.zh: 这家药店所在的购物中心，正是莎莉周五参加泳池派对时停车的地方。

sentences.en: This added weight to the theory that Shari's abductor might have spotted her that day and followed her home.
sentences.zh: 这增加了这样一种理论的权重：莎莉的绑架者可能那天就盯上了她，并一路跟踪她回家。

sentences.en: The Smith family didn't know what to make of this turn of events.
sentences.zh: 史密斯一家不知道该如何看待这一事态发展。

sentences.en: While the contents of Shari's letter were deeply troubling, they refused to give up hope that she could still be found alive.
sentences.zh: 虽然莎莉信中的内容令人深感不安，但他们拒绝放弃她还活着的希望。

sentences.en: Maybe her harrowing words were meant as some kind of code.
sentences.zh: 也许她那些令人揪心的话语是一种密码。

sentences.en: At 8.07pm that same night, the phone rang again.
sentences.zh: 当晚8点07分，电话再次响起。

sentences.en: When Dawn answered, she immediately recognised the voice of her sister's kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 道恩接起电话时，立刻认出了她姐姐绑架者的声音。

sentences.en: He asked Dawn if she had come down from Charlotte.
sentences.zh: 他问道恩是不是从夏洛特过来的。

sentences.en: Dawn said yes and asked who she was speaking to.
sentences.zh: 道恩说是，并问她是在和谁说话。

sentences.en: The caller ignored her and said,
sentences.zh: 通话者无视了她，说道：

sentences.en: I need to speak to your mother.
sentences.zh: “我需要和你母亲说话。”

sentences.en: Tell her to hurry.
sentences.zh: “告诉她快点。”

sentences.en: Hilda picked up.
sentences.zh: 希尔达接过了电话。

sentences.en: The caller asked,
sentences.zh: 通话者问道：

sentences.en: Did you receive the letter today?
sentences.zh: “你今天收到信了吗？”

sentences.en: Hilda responded that she had.
sentences.zh: 希尔达回答说收到了。

sentences.en: To prove it, the caller asked her to tell him one thing that the letter said.
sentences.zh: 为了证明这一点，通话者让她说出信里写的一件事。

sentences.en: Shari had drawn a love heart with a combination of hers and her boyfriend Richard's names in it.
sentences.zh: 莎莉画了一个爱心，里面写着她和男友理查德的名字。

sentences.en: Hilda told the caller this, confirming that the two-page letter was written on yellow legal paper.
sentences.zh: 希尔达告诉了通话者，并确认那封两页的信确实写在黄色法律用纸上。

sentences.en: The caller stated,
sentences.zh: 通话者说道：

sentences.en: Okay, so you know now that this is not a hoax call.
sentences.zh: “好吧，现在你知道这不是恶作剧电话了。”

sentences.en: He then asked why his request for Sheriff Matt's to call off the search hadn't been met, saying,
sentences.zh: 他随后询问为什么他要求梅茨警长取消搜查的请求没有得到满足，并说：

sentences.en: I'm trying to do everything possible to answer some of your prayers.
sentences.zh: “我正在尽一切可能来回应你们的一些祈祷。”

sentences.en: So please, in the name of God, work with us here.
sentences.zh: “所以，以上帝的名义，请配合我们。”

sentences.en: Hilda spoke kindly to the man, asking if he could just tell her whether Shari was okay without her medicine.
sentences.zh: 希尔达温和地对那人说话，问他能不能告诉她，莎莉没有药能不能撑住。

sentences.en: The caller said that Shari was drinking two gallons of water per hour and going to the bathroom afterwards.
sentences.zh: 通话者说莎莉每小时喝两加仑水，之后会上厕所。

sentences.en: He told Hilda he had to hurry as he knew the calls were being traced.
sentences.zh: 他告诉希尔达他必须快点，因为他知道电话正在被追踪。

sentences.en: This has gone too far, he said.
sentences.zh: “这太过分了，”他说。

sentences.en: Please forgive me.
sentences.zh: “请原谅我。”

sentences.en: The caller told Hilda to have an ambulance ready at their home.
sentences.zh: 通话者告诉希尔达准备好救护车停在他们家。

sentences.en: He claimed that if anything happened to Shari, in addition to her request for a closed casket, she wanted to have her hands crossed over her chest as though in prayer.
sentences.zh: 他声称，如果莎莉出了什么事，除了她要求封棺外，她还希望双手交叉放在胸前，就像在祈祷一样。

sentences.en: Listen to us please, the caller implored.
sentences.zh: “请听我们说，”通话者恳求道。

sentences.en: Forget Lexington County.
sentences.zh: “忘了列克星敦县吧。”

sentences.en: Look in Saluda County.
sentences.zh: “去萨卢达县找。”

sentences.en: Do you understand?
sentences.zh: “你明白吗？”

sentences.en: Shari Faye requests no strangers when we give the location.
sentences.zh: “莎莉·费要求我们提供位置时不要有陌生人在场。”

sentences.en: Hilda reassured the caller that nobody was going to cause any harm.
sentences.zh: 希尔达向通话者保证，没有人会伤害她。

sentences.en: She just wanted to know whether Shari was with him.
sentences.zh: 她只想知道莎莉是否和他在一起。

sentences.en: The caller said he couldn't tell Hilda that, but, quote,
sentences.zh: 通话者说他不能告诉希尔达，但是，引用他的话：

sentences.en: I want to tell you one other thing.
sentences.zh: “我想告诉你另一件事。”

sentences.en: Shari is now part of me.
sentences.zh: “莎莉现在是我的一部分了。”

sentences.en: Physically, mentally, emotionally, spiritually.
sentences.zh: “身体上、精神上、情感上、灵魂上。”

sentences.en: Our souls are one now.
sentences.zh: “我们的灵魂现在合二为一了。”

sentences.en: Hilda begged the caller to tell Shari how much her family loved her and that they'd do anything to make her happy.
sentences.zh: 希尔达恳求通话者告诉莎莉，她的家人有多爱她，他们愿意做任何事让她开心。

sentences.en: Again, the caller repeated his demands to have an ambulance ready.
sentences.zh: 通话者再次重复了他要求准备救护车的要求。

sentences.en: Hilda urged him to call back again later that night, saying,
sentences.zh: 希尔达敦促他当晚晚些时候再打来，并说：

sentences.en: God bless you for taking care of my baby.
sentences.zh: “上帝保佑你照顾我的孩子。”

sentences.en: The caller continued,
sentences.zh: 通话者继续说道：

sentences.en: I got to go now.
sentences.zh: “我得走了。”

sentences.en: Listen, listen.
sentences.zh: “听着，听着。”

sentences.en: Please, please, please forgive me for this.
sentences.zh: “请，请，请原谅我做的一切。”

sentences.en: It just got out of hand.
sentences.zh: “事情失控了。”

sentences.en: Shari is protected now.
sentences.zh: “莎莉现在受到保护了。”

sentences.en: She is part of me now.
sentences.zh: “她现在是我的一部分了。”

sentences.en: And God look after all of us now.
sentences.zh: “愿上帝保佑我们所有人。”

sentences.en: Good night.
sentences.zh: “晚安。”

sentences.en: The cryptic phone call left investigators scrambling for answers.
sentences.zh: 这通神秘的电话让调查人员忙于寻找答案。

sentences.en: The kidnapper still hadn't provided any proof of life, and it remained unclear whether Shari had been harmed or not.
sentences.zh: 绑架者仍然没有提供任何莎莉还活着的证据，也不清楚莎莉是否受到了伤害。

sentences.en: The call was traced to a gas station just off the interstate 20 highway, approximately eight miles from the Smiths' home.
sentences.zh: 电话被追踪到20号州际公路旁的一个加油站，距离史密斯家约八英里。

sentences.en: But again, the caller had left behind no evidence.
sentences.zh: 但同样，通话者没有留下任何证据。

sentences.en: Although, the information gained thus far did allow renowned FBI criminal profiler John Douglas to put together a 22-point profile of the perpetrator.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，目前获得的信息确实让著名的FBI犯罪侧写师约翰·道格拉斯整理出了一份关于肇事者的22点侧写。

sentences.en: According to Douglas,
sentences.zh: 据道格拉斯称：

sentences.en: Shari's abductor was a white male, most likely in his mid to late 20s, but possibly in his early 30s.
sentences.zh: 莎莉的绑架者是一名白人男性，很可能在20多岁到30岁出头之间。

sentences.en: He was single, but had probably been married in the past or had a history of failed relationships.
sentences.zh: 他单身，但过去可能结过婚，或者有失败的恋爱史。

sentences.en: If he had a child of his own, that child would no longer be in his custody.
sentences.zh: 如果他有自己的孩子，那孩子现在也不在他监护之下。

sentences.en: He would either live alone or with parents or older relatives.
sentences.zh: 他要么独居，要么与父母或年长的亲戚住在一起。

sentences.en: This wouldn't be the perpetrator's first crime.
sentences.zh: 这不会是肇事者的第一次犯罪。

sentences.en: He likely had a criminal record that included anything from making obscene phone calls and peeping and prying to full-blown sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 他很可能有犯罪记录，包括打骚扰电话、偷窥、甚至严重的性侵犯。

sentences.en: He'd keep trophies taken from his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他会保留从受害者身上拿走的战利品。

sentences.en: He'd have a penchant for pornography, with a particular lust for bondage and sadomasochism.
sentences.zh: 他有色情癖好，特别迷恋捆绑和施虐受虐。

sentences.en: The evidence indicated that Shari Smith had been taken by force, likely at knife or gunpoint.
sentences.zh: 证据表明莎莉·史密斯是被强行带走的，很可能是在刀枪威胁下。

sentences.en: This indicated that the perpetrator wasn't particularly charming or attractive, as he knew he wouldn't be able to lure Shari into his car through any other means.
sentences.zh: 这表明作案者并不怎么迷人或有吸引力，因为他知道自己无法通过其他手段诱骗莎莉上车。

sentences.en: He was likely overweight and suffered from low self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 他很可能超重，且患有自卑症。

sentences.en: His crimes would be motivated by his prevailing fantasy of exerting power over unattainable women.
sentences.zh: 他的犯罪动机源于他内心深处那种想要掌控高不可攀的女性的幻想。

sentences.en: He likely picked female victims that he had no chance of a relationship with in his daily life, therefore forging a sense of power and control.
sentences.zh: 他很可能挑选那些在日常生活中他根本没机会建立关系的女性作为受害者，从而获得一种权力和控制感。

sentences.en: Those victims would likely be children or young girls, as he'd find adult women too intimidating.
sentences.zh: 这些受害者很可能是儿童或年轻女孩，因为他会觉得成年女性太令他畏惧。

sentences.en: Investigators determined that the perpetrator was using a variable speed control device to alter the sound of his voice.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确定作案者正在使用一种变速控制装置来改变他的声音。

sentences.en: This indicated a knowledge of electronics that suggested the perpetrator likely worked in electrical contracting, a job that provided flexible hours and the freedom to move around.
sentences.zh: 这表明他具备电子学知识，暗示作案者可能从事电气承包工作，这种工作时间灵活，且有自由走动的空间。

sentences.en: Although the device distorted the caller's voice, it couldn't disguise his slight southern accent.
sentences.zh: 尽管该装置扭曲了来电者的声音，但仍无法掩盖他轻微的南方口音。

sentences.en: In his first phone call, the perpetrator had told Hilda Smith to expect a letter from Shari at 2pm.
sentences.zh: 在第一次通话中，作案者曾告诉希尔达·史密斯，下午两点会收到莎莉的信。

sentences.en: Two o'clock was their usual mail delivery time.
sentences.zh: 两点钟是他们平时的邮件投递时间。

sentences.en: This, in addition to the perpetrator's knowledge of the surrounding counties and his use of various payphones, gave John Douglas no doubt that the offender lived locally
sentences.zh: 这一点，加上作案者对周边县区的了解以及他使用各种公用电话的行为，让约翰·道格拉斯确信罪犯就住在当地，

sentences.en: or was at the very least familiar with the area.
sentences.zh: 或者至少对该地区非常熟悉。

sentences.en: The perpetrator knew that Dawn Smith had travelled down from Charlotte.
sentences.zh: 作案者知道道恩·史密斯是从夏洛特过来的。

sentences.en: He'd also used Shari's middle name, Faye.
sentences.zh: 他还叫出了莎莉的中间名，费伊。

sentences.en: Did this mean he knew the Smith family on a personal level?
sentences.zh: 这是否意味着他与史密斯一家私下认识？

sentences.en: The payphone locations also suggested something else of note.
sentences.zh: 公用电话的位置也暗示了其他值得注意的事情。

sentences.en: Each call had come from a different location and each area had been wiped clean.
sentences.zh: 每次通话都来自不同的地点，而且每个区域都被清理得干干净净。

sentences.en: The fact that the offender knew his calls were being traced, coupled with his use of a voice-altering device, indicated a knowledge of forensic proceedings.
sentences.zh: 罪犯知道他的通话正在被追踪，再加上他使用了变声装置，这表明他了解法医调查程序。

sentences.en: Whoever he was, investigators were dealing with someone of above-average intelligence.
sentences.zh: 无论他是谁，调查人员面对的都是一个智力超群的人。

sentences.en: John Douglas determined that the perpetrator was meticulous and obsessive in his daily habits.
sentences.zh: 约翰·道格拉斯断定作案者在日常生活中是一个一丝不苟且有强迫症的人。

sentences.en: He likely had everything planned out, with the tone of his voice hinting that he was reading from a script.
sentences.zh: 他很可能把一切都计划好了，他说话的语调暗示他是在照着稿子念。

sentences.en: He was a rigid thinker who probably had an unsuccessful previous career in the military.
sentences.zh: 他是一个思维僵化的人，可能之前在军队里的职业生涯并不成功。

sentences.en: Sheriff James Metz told reporters, I feel we're looking for an extremely sharp individual in one regard and an extremely psychotic individual in another regard.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·梅茨警长告诉记者：“我觉得我们正在寻找的人，一方面极其精明，另一方面又极其精神病态。”

sentences.en: He seems to be almost schizophrenic, one who thinks clearly and acts irrationally.
sentences.zh: “他看起来几乎是精神分裂，一个思维清晰却行为非理性的人。”

sentences.en: By Tuesday June 4, the investigation into Shari Smith's disappearance rolled into its fourth day.
sentences.zh: 到6月4日星期二，对莎莉·史密斯失踪案的调查进入了第四天。

sentences.en: Convinced that the perpetrator was following the story in the media, the Smith family made another television appeal for Shari's safe return, with Dawn telling her sister,
sentences.zh: 史密斯一家确信作案者正在关注媒体报道，于是再次通过电视呼吁莎莉平安归来，道恩对她的妹妹说：

sentences.en: We're not a family without you.
sentences.zh: “没有你，我们就不再是一个完整的家庭了。”

sentences.en: Hilda added,
sentences.zh: 希尔达补充道：

sentences.en: Shari, we love you so much.
sentences.zh: “莎莉，我们非常爱你。”

sentences.en: We're just not going to give up on finding you.
sentences.zh: “我们绝不会放弃寻找你。”

sentences.en: I know you're being taken care of.
sentences.zh: “我知道你现在有人照顾。”

sentences.en: We just feel such assurances from the Lord that you will be with us again.
sentences.zh: “我们从主那里感受到了强烈的保证，你一定会回到我们身边。”

sentences.en: Empathetic of their plight, the community continued to rally behind the Smiths, with volunteers distributing over 10,000 missing person posters around town.
sentences.zh: 社区对他们的困境感同身受，继续支持史密斯一家，志愿者们在镇上分发了超过一万张寻人启事。

sentences.en: Concerned citizens contributed to the reward pool, increasing the amount to $25,000.
sentences.zh: 热心市民纷纷向悬赏金池捐款，将金额提高到了25,000美元。

sentences.en: Still, nothing led to the identity of Shari's kidnapper.
sentences.zh: 然而，依然没有任何线索指向莎莉绑架者的身份。

sentences.en: By nine o'clock on Tuesday night, over 24 hours had passed since the offender last made contact.
sentences.zh: 到周二晚上九点，距离罪犯最后一次联系已经过去了24个多小时。

sentences.en: The Smith family sat on edge, unable to sleep as they awaited further instructions that they weren't even sure would come.
sentences.zh: 史密斯一家如坐针毡，无法入睡，等待着他们甚至不确定是否会再来的进一步指示。

sentences.en: Then, at 9.45pm, the phone finally rang.
sentences.zh: 然后，在晚上9点45分，电话终于响了。

sentences.en: Dawn answered it.
sentences.zh: 道恩接了电话。

sentences.en: It was Shari's abductor.
sentences.zh: 是莎莉的绑架者。

sentences.en: He asked Dawn to put Hilda on the other line and to grab a pencil and paper.
sentences.zh: 他要求道恩让希尔达接听另一条线，并拿好纸笔。

sentences.en: This is Shari's own words, he said.
sentences.zh: “这是莎莉的原话，”他说。

sentences.en: So listen carefully.
sentences.zh: “所以仔细听好。”

sentences.en: Say nothing unless you're asked.
sentences.zh: “除非被问到，否则什么都别说。”

sentences.en: I know these calls are taped and traced, but that's irrelevant now.
sentences.zh: “我知道这些通话被录音和追踪了，但这现在无关紧要。”

sentences.en: There's no money demanded.
sentences.zh: “没有索要任何钱财。”

sentences.en: So here's Shari Faye's last requeSt.
sentences.zh: “这是莎莉·费伊最后的请求。”

sentences.en: On the fifth day to put the family at rest,
sentences.zh: “在第五天让家人安心，”

sentences.en: Shari Faye being freed.
sentences.zh: “莎莉·费伊将被释放。”

sentences.en: Remember, we are one soul now.
sentences.zh: “记住，我们现在是一个灵魂。”

sentences.en: When located, you'll locate both of us together.
sentences.zh: “当找到时，你们会同时找到我们两个。”

sentences.en: We are one.
sentences.zh: “我们是一体的。”

sentences.en: God has chosen us.
sentences.zh: “上帝选择了我们。”

sentences.en: Respect all past and present requests.
sentences.zh: “尊重所有过去和现在的请求。”

sentences.en: The caller told the women to jot down the actual times and events.
sentences.zh: 来电者告诉她们记下具体的时间和事件。

sentences.en: He said the kidnapping happened at 3.28pm on Friday May 31 and that Shari, quote,
sentences.zh: 他说绑架发生在5月31日星期五下午3点28分，并且莎莉，引用原话，

sentences.en: had the fear of God in her.
sentences.zh: “对上帝怀有敬畏之心。”

sentences.en: At 3.10am on Saturday June 1, she wrote her last will and testament.
sentences.zh: “在6月1日星期六凌晨3点10分，她写下了最后的遗嘱。”

sentences.en: At 4.58am, the two, quote, became one soul.
sentences.zh: “在凌晨4点58分，两人，引用原话，‘合二为一’。”

sentences.en: Hilda asked the caller what he meant by that.
sentences.zh: 希尔达问来电者那是什么意思。

sentences.en: He continued, no questions now, and instructed them to have an ambulance ready between four and seven o'clock the following evening.
sentences.zh: 他继续说：“现在不要问问题，”并指示她们在第二天傍晚四点到七点之间准备好救护车。

sentences.en: Prayers and relief coming soon, he said.
sentences.zh: “祈祷和解脱即将到来，”他说。

sentences.en: Please learn to enjoy life.
sentences.zh: “请学会享受生活。”

sentences.en: Forgive.
sentences.zh: “宽恕。”

sentences.en: God protects the chosen.
sentences.zh: “上帝保护被选中的人。”

sentences.en: Again, he ordered Sheriff Metz to call off the search, adding,
sentences.zh: 他再次命令梅茨警长停止搜查，并补充道：

sentences.en: blessings are near.
sentences.zh: “祝福就在眼前。”

sentences.en: You will receive last instructions where to find us.
sentences.zh: “你们会收到关于在哪里找到我们的最后指示。”

sentences.en: Hilda pleaded with the man not to kill her daughter.
sentences.zh: 希尔达恳求那个人不要杀她的女儿。

sentences.en: He ignored her, concluding, we love and miss you all.
sentences.zh: 他无视了她，最后说道：“我们爱你们，想念你们所有人。”

sentences.en: Get good rest tonight.
sentences.zh: “今晚好好休息。”

sentences.en: Goodbye.
sentences.zh: “再见。”

sentences.en: The call was traced to a payphone at a convenience store at Lake Murray, nine miles from the Smith's home.
sentences.zh: 通话被追踪到距离史密斯家九英里外的一家便利店的公用电话上。

sentences.en: Again, no fingerprints or other evidence had been left behind.
sentences.zh: 同样，没有留下指纹或其他证据。

sentences.en: Officers established roadblocks in the area, but nothing brought them closer to identifying the perpetrator or finding Shari.
sentences.zh: 警察在该地区设立了路障，但没有任何进展，无法确定作案者身份或找到莎莉。

sentences.en: Based on the caller's instructions, police feared that they could be dealing with the murder-suicide.
sentences.zh: 根据来电者的指示，警方担心他们可能正在处理一起谋杀自杀案。

sentences.en: However, behavioural profiler John Douglas believed that the perpetrator was, quote, too full of himself and his perceived power to take his own life.
